scripts.build: npm run build -w showboard && node plugins/claude-code/build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/showboard --noEmit && tsc -p packages/showboard/tsconfig.viewer.json && tsc -p examples/sales-demo --noEmit && tsc -p examples/pages-demo --noEmit
scripts.test:pane: node plugins/claude-code/build.mjs && claude plugin validate plugins/claude-code && claude plugin test plugins/claude-code
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start -w sales-demo
